name: roost
description: A home for your remote coding agents, built for herdr. Claude Code, Codex, opencode and friends run in this container and you drive them over SSH with herdr (herdr.dev): close the laptop and they keep working; reattach from another machine or your phone. Pubkey-only SSH as user agent, no sudo, no Docker socket. Paste your public key(s) into Public keys (comma-separated), then connect: ssh -p 2222 agent@ . First start installs the tools (a few minutes, see the log).

paths.name: Home
paths.description: Logins, repos and tools. Survives updates.

paths.name: SSH identity
paths.description: Host key (generated on first start) and extra authorized_keys.

ports.name: SSH port
ports.description: Port your devices connect to (ssh -p 2222 agent@unraid). Keep it on LAN/VPN.

variables.name: Public keys
variables.description: SSH public keys allowed to log in as agent, comma-separated (laptop, phone, ...).

variables.name: Heeler pairing
variables.description: 1 = pair phones with Heeler by QR (run roost-pair in the box). Lets ~/.ssh/authorized_keys grant logins, which agents in the box can write.

variables.name: Heeler addresses
variables.description: Addresses the phone reaches Unraid on (LAN IP, Tailscale IP, DNS name), comma-separated. Go into the pairing QR.

variables.name: Heeler port
variables.description: Port for the pairing QR. Keep it equal to SSH port.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns the home folder.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns the home folder.

variables.name: Git user.name
variables.description: Git identity for commits made in the box.

variables.name: Git user.email
variables.description: Git identity for commits made in the box.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Optional. Logs gh in on start and lets git use it for HTTPS. Fine-grained, only the repos you need.

variables.name: Harnesses
variables.description: Coding agents to install (mise ids, space-separated).

variables.name: Tools
variables.value: herdr uv gh glab npm:ccusage npm:playwright npm:@playwright/mcp
variables.description: Extra tools (mise specs). herdr is required.
